Emmanouil Stavrakakis

I am a PhD student in mathematics at ENS de Lyon, working at the Institut Camille Jordan (ICJ) under the supervision of Professor Guillaume Aubrun.

My research interests lie in high-dimensional probability, convex geometry, and functional analysis.
